rules: Each finding has its own written search of every PubMed record in Europe PMC (titles and abstracts); all reviews, randomised trials and guidelines it found were downloaded.
Left out animal studies (MeSH tags, or the title when there are none) and retracted papers.
A review counts for a finding when the finding's search found it and the finding's words are in its title.

Reviews: meta-analyses or systematic reviews of any design, because much of what is known about eating beetroot comes from studies that follow people over years, as well as from trials. Chosen: the three newest meta-analyses (systematic reviews only if fewer than three), plus the most comprehensive one (most studies pooled, read from the abstract). Citations are shown but do not choose.
Newer large trials: randomised trials of at least 1,000 people (read from the abstract) from the year of the newest chosen review on, which those reviews may not include.

Historical screening decisions and review choices are retained. Exact screening inputs and per-decision model provenance were not recorded, so they are not validated for current inputs. Legacy file attribution is shown per outcome; these decisions need fresh screening before a new build may select them.
Overlap is not shown: a bibliography can cite background or excluded trials and cannot establish which studies a review included or pooled.

left.title: Health benefits of beetroot supplementation in older adults: A systematic review of blood pressure and functional implications

left.reason: It pools dietary nitrate RCTs on BP without a separate beetroot juice analysis reported in the abstract.

left.title: Effects of beetroot juice on blood pressure in hypertension according to European Society of Hypertension Guidelines: A systematic review and meta-analysis
left.reason: Beetroot juice vs placebo/water/no intake on BP matches, but the population is limited to adults with hypertension.

left.title: Regulatory effect of dietary nitrate on blood pressure: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials

left.title: Nitrate Derived From Beetroot Juice Lowers Blood Pressure in Patients With Arterial Hypertension: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
left.reason: Beetroot juice vs control on BP matches, but the population is limited to patients with arterial hypertension.

left.title: Effectiveness of dietary inorganic nitrate for lowering blood pressure in hypertensive adults: a systematic review

left.title: Erratum for Bahadoran et al. The nitrate-independent blood pressure-lowering effect of beetroot juice: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Adv Nutr 2017;8(6):830-8
left.reason: This is an erratum notice, not a systematic review.

left.title: Medium-term effects of dietary nitrate supplementation on systolic and diastolic blood pressure in adults: a systematic review and meta-analysis
left.reason: It pools inorganic nitrate and beetroot juice vs placebo on BP without a separate beetroot-only analysis in the abstract.

left.title: Ageing modifies the effects of beetroot juice supplementation on 24-hour blood pressure variability: An individual participant meta-analysis
left.reason: Pooled RCTs of beetroot juice vs placebo, but only older participants and mainly 24-h BP variability outcomes.

left.title: Inorganic nitrate and beetroot juice supplementation reduces blood pressure in adults: a systematic review and meta-analysis
left.reason: It pools inorganic nitrate and beetroot juice vs placebo on BP without a separate beetroot-only analysis reported.

left.title: Dietary Nitrate Supplementation and Exercise Performance: An Umbrella Review of 20 Published Systematic Reviews with Meta-analyses

left.title: Does Nitrate Supplementation Improve Muscle Strength, Power, and Sprint Performance in Females? A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis

left.title: Effects of Beetroot-Based Supplements on Muscular Endurance and Strength in Healthy Male Individuals: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis

left.title: Does Co-Supplementation with Beetroot Juice and Other Nutritional Supplements Positively Impact Sports Performance?: A Systematic Review
left.reason: Beetroot juice and sports performance, but it reviews beetroot combined with other supplements rather than vs placebo alone.

left.title: Does Beetroot Supplementation Improve Performance in Combat Sports Athletes? A Systematic Review of Randomized Controlled Trials

left.title: Effects of Dietary Nitrate Supplementation on Back Squat and Bench Press Performance: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis

left.title: The effects of nitrate ingestion on high-intensity endurance time-trial performance: A systematic review and meta-analysis

left.title: The Effect of Nitrate-Rich Beetroot Juice on Markers of Exercise-Induced Muscle Damage: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Human Intervention Trials

left.title: The Effects of Dietary Nitrate Supplementation on Explosive Exercise Performance: A Systematic Review

left.title: Impact of dietary nitrate supplementation on exercise capacity and cardiovascular parameters in chronic respiratory disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis

left.title: Effects of Dietary Nitrates on Time Trial Performance in Athletes with Different Training Status: Systematic Review

left.title: Effects of Dietary Nitrate Supplementation on Weightlifting Exercise Performance in Healthy Adults: A Systematic Review

left.title: Performance and Health Benefits of Dietary Nitrate Supplementation in Older Adults: A Systematic Review

left.title: The Effect of Dietary Nitrate Supplementation on Endurance Exercise Performance in Healthy Adults: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis

left.reason: Pools time-to-exhaustion and time-trial results in healthy people, but mixes beetroot juice with sodium nitrate and does not analyse beetroot on its own.
